name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.51-beta “Paris” (build 52): Prepare for Filing, honest PDF conversion, Update List of Exhibits.
• Submission ▸ Prepare for Filing…: saves a filing copy of your brief — citations as plain text, author and personal information removed, tracked changes and comments dealt with, optionally a PDF — then checks it for names and file paths that give away who wrote it. The original is never changed.
• Bundles and e-briefs say when a document couldn't be converted to PDF, and why — and warn before they start when no converter is installed.
• Submission ▸ Update List of Exhibits rebuilds the list (and the Index of Authorities) in place without renumbering.
• Case names are in italics in the List of Exhibits and the Index of Authorities; names like “Gas Natural SDG, S.A. v. Argentine Republic” are recognised in full.
• Clean Metadata also removes the list of people who commented or edited.
